purpose: Independently verify and promote the discovered jq structured-data capability.
goal: Verify jq can transform repository-local JSON into deterministic text and independently reproduce the semantic result with Python.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
p=root/'canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('astra_runtime_jq_verify',p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); sys.modules[s.name]=m; s.loader.exec_module(m)
args={
 'capability_id':'json.query.jq',
 'input_path':'canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json',
 'filter':'.capabilities | keys | sort | .[]',
 'output_path':'canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/JQ_CAPABILITY_IDS.txt',
 'raw_output':True,'require_nonempty':True,'timeout_s':60
}
out=m._invoke_bound_capability(args)
ev=root/'canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-VERIFY-JQ-STRUCTURED-DATA-001__JQ.json'
ev.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
assert out.get('output_verified') is True
print('JQ_PENDING_CAPABILITY_EXECUTED')
PY

set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
reg=json.loads((root/'canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())
expected=sorted(reg['capabilities'].keys())
p=root/'canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/JQ_CAPABILITY_IDS.txt'
observed=[x for x in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if x]
assert observed==expected,(observed,expected)
ev={
 'schema':'PROJECT_BRAIN_INDEPENDENT_SEMANTIC_VERIFICATION_V1',
 'verified':True,'verifier':'python-stdlib-json',
 'expected':expected,'observed':observed,
 'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
}
(root/'canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-VERIFY-JQ-STRUCTURED-DATA-001__INDEPENDENT.json').write_text(json.dumps(ev,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('JQ_INDEPENDENT_SEMANTIC_VERIFIED')
PY

set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
rp=root/'canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json'
reg=json.loads(rp.read_text())
cap=reg['capabilities']['json.query.jq']
assert cap['status']=='BOUND_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION'
ie=json.loads((root/'canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-VERIFY-JQ-STRUCTURED-DATA-001__INDEPENDENT.json').read_text())
assert ie.get('verified') is True
cap['status']='VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY'
cap['verification']={
 'mission_id':'ASTRA-VERIFY-JQ-STRUCTURED-DATA-001',
 'independent_verifier':'python-stdlib-json',
 'independent_verified':True,
 'verification_evidence':'canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-VERIFY-JQ-STRUCTURED-DATA-001__INDEPENDENT.json'
}
rp.write_text(json.dumps(reg,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('JQ_CAPABILITY_PROMOTED')
PY
